name: Chinese LLM Safety Assessment Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate the safety performance of Chinese large language models across 8 typical safety scenarios and 6 challenging instruction attacks, using test prompts and LLM-based safety evaluation.
reputation: A niche but relevant benchmark for Chinese LLM safety research, mainly cited in work on safety alignment and jailbreak robustness rather than broad general-purpose evaluation.
notes: Includes 100k augmented prompts and responses (SafetyPrompts) released publicly; focuses on safety and instruction attacks.
